title: Stationary point, no reversal · Set 3
statement:
For $f(x)=(x-[$a])^3$, find the input of a local extremum, or enter DNE.

[__________]{a}
hints: Find where the derivative is zero.
Check its sign to each side.
A nonnegative square does not switch signs.
solution: $f'=3(x-[$a])^2>0$ on both sides. The graph increases through the point, so neither extreme occurs.

feedback.message: A nonnegative square does not switch signs.
